notes.title: Version update & game name change
notes.notes:
At present, the game has updated a series of optimizations, and updated the second new map "Castle" with better performance. The second map has a better art style, higher frame rate, and supports 10 people to play together.

In addition, due to legal and authorization reasons, we can no longer use the SCP Foundation as a background setting. The game has been updated with a new game background setting. Please understand.

notes.title: Sorry for the 6/7 update, we have fixed the bugs
notes.notes: Some serious bugs occurs because we add rag doll effect to the bodies after 6/7 update. We have remove it, really sorry for that.

notes.title: 2021/4/2 Gameplay update
notes.notes:
According to players' feed back, we made some gameplay update:

1. Add some power supply to the map. Every 60 to 90 seconds, 2 of the power supply will fail and squad member need to fix it in time. When the power supply is failing, player can't recover data.

2. Add 3 supply box to the map. When player recover data, they have chance to get access to one of the supply box. Supply box contain pistol and medkit.

3.Reduce ammo of security to 1.

4.Now, Imposter can pickup pistol and medkit from body

If you have any feedback or you want to report bug, please join our discord group https://discord.gg/wU3NpeHt5h
